Custer’s Last Stand was an historical event that occurred during the American Civil War. On June 26, 1876, the Battle of Little Big Horn took place, in which the Lakota and Northern Cheyenne tribes fought against the 7th Cavalry led by George Custer. The battle resulted in the tribes victory and Custer’s defeat and death. This event was a major turning point in the American Civil War, leading to the resignation of General George A. Custer and subsequent surrender of the Lakota and Northern Cheyenne tribes.
